# sh-fpv-compatibility

**Purpose:** Why this match fits: keywords, preference match and the Astro cue.

**Switches:** Astro cue = on only when both have added birth details and the score is 18/36 or more (South 6/10). Version = v1 Keywords (default) or Phase 2 AI summary (off in v1).

**Taps:** AI summary Read More (Phase 2 only).
